subject: Capri-9.5B-lite onboarding — temporary variant pin & compatibility checks
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Capri-9.5B-lite onboarding — temporary variant pin & compatibility checks

Hi Priyom / Dev,

Short version: Neptune Analytics wants to run a controlled canary on a trimmed variant we onboarded from their release (Capri-9.5B-lite, PTQ profile). Before we expose traffic we need a temporary server-side version pin for the variant (two-week window) while we validate compatibility and telemetry.

Asks:
- Ops: apply a temporary pin for capri-9.5b-lite -> variant id capri-lite-v1 on the canary pool (2 weeks).
- Infra: run a compatibility sanity pass (tokenizer parity, KV cache behavior, batch packing) on staging.
- Product/Telemetry: confirm existing telemetry hooks capture token-per-second and detach rate for prefix caching.
- Safety: quick smoke for prompt-injection indicators (QA harness will run).

Proposed rollout cadence: Nov 24 03:00 UTC start (canary at 1% for 24h -> 5% next 48h). If we see no regressions we lift pin after two weeks.

Attachments: capri9.5b_compat_matrix.xlsx, capri9.5b_bench_v1.pdf, neptune_canary_map.csv (artifact links in the ticket below).

Why temporary pin: Neptune's integration relies on a variant that deviates subtly in tokenizer join behavior; if we let automatic variant routing run we risk routing them to an untested build. Pin prevents accidental roll-forward during the canary window.

If you need additional perf vectors or a specific S3 artifact path I can push those.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Product Manager, Model Onboarding
Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:34:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Capri-9.5B-lite onboarding — temporary variant pin & compatibility checks

Tessa —

Thanks for the heads-up. A few quick items before Ops can safely pin and recommend the staging window: 

1) Can you confirm the quantization profile used for "lite"? (PTQ per-layer vs global, and any custom clipping). We need the exact profile to validate kernel selection.
2) Bench PDF looks useful but I need tokenization delta numbers vs. our baseline (tokens in/out for the same prompt set). The PDF has aggregate latency p50/p95 but not token delta.
3) Is there a model artifact S3 path or HF repo we can pull to run an end-to-end KV cache run?
4) Any special custom ops? If the artifact requires nonstandard ops we need to schedule a quick build.

If you can drop those by EOD today I can queue the compatibility jobs (tokenizer parity, perf with sample batching profiles) and should have results by Nov 23.

- Dev

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Capri-9.5B-lite onboarding — temporary variant pin & compatibility checks

All —

I pulled the artifacts from the Drive link and kicked off a quick baseline. Answers inline: 
- Quant profile: PTQ per-channel, asymmetric integer8 target, clipping at 99.5. I've uploaded the raw quant config to the ticket.
- Token delta: sample harness shows +2 tokens per prompt on average (mostly from bracketing behavior). I'll attach the CSV to the ticket.
- Ops/Custom ops: no extra custom ops; model is standard attention + rotary.

Proposed staging window: Nov 24 03:00-06:00 UTC (low traffic). Run compatibility matrix (sheet attached) across batch sizes [1,4,8], both kv-prefetch on/off. If ok, proceed with canary 1% -> escalate to 5% per Tessa's cadence.

Fallback plan: if the variant exhibits tokenization drift beyond threshold (>5 tokens median) or p95 SLA regressions > 20% relative, we fallback to capri-9.5b-standard (already validated) and pin routing to that.

Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-3247 — I've added the quant config and sample outputs.

—Priyom

From: Elena Kozlova <elena@neptune.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal@neptune.ai
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Capri-9.5B-lite onboarding — temporary variant pin & compatibility checks

Tessa —

Thanks for coordinating. Neptune is prepared to run the canary on Nov 24 as proposed. A couple of asks from our side:
- Our security officer needs the SOC2 evidence and a link to your incident response runbook. Can you share a point of contact?
- We will run a short internal prompt coverage test and share results by Nov 26.

I'll loop in our infra lead if we need any special headers or traffic shaping on our side.

Laura / Ops — can you please apply a temporary server-side pin to variant id capri-lite-v1 on the canary pool starting Nov 24 03:00 UTC for two weeks? Priyom has validated the quant profile and token delta; Dev will run the compatibility jobs and post the outputs in RINF-3247.

Action summary: 
- Laura: apply pin (capri-lite-v1) and confirm when done. Attach pin metadata (reason: Neptune canary) and expiry (2026-12-08).
- Dev: run tokenizer parity and perf runs on staging (batch 1,4,8) and post results by Nov 23 EOD.
- Priyom: monitor telemetry during canary; fallback to capri-9.5b-standard if token drift or p95 regressions exceed thresholds.
- Elena: Neptune will share internal prompt coverage by Nov 26.

Attachments referenced: capri9.5b_compat_matrix.xlsx, capri9.5b_bench_v1.pdf, neptune_canary_map.csv

Thanks all — please reply with any blockers.

Tessa
